masterTaxonomy.name: AviList: The Global Avian Checklist
masterTaxonomy.notes: Use AviList v2025b as the current consensus master checklist. IOC World Bird List v15.2 is retained only as a historical/reference source because IOC announced v15.2 as its final independent update and encouraged adoption of AviList.

enrichment.name: Wikipedia
enrichment.notes: Use Wikipedia for introductory descriptions and lead images only. Structured fields such as diet, breeding and conservation should be separately verified.

thaiNames.notes: Thai common names are enrichment data and are not accepted by the guessing input.

phylogeny.name: MetaAves Phylogenetic Clade Layer
phylogeny.notes: Maintain clades separately from ranked taxonomy. Example: Telluraves is a clade and must not be encoded as an order/family. Clades can contain multiple orders and can be nested between ranked nodes.
